FatFs R0.15 (revision 80286) by ChaN — http://elm-chan.org/fsw/ff/

Copied from km003c_rp2_webapp's third_party/fatfs, which took them from
tinyusb's lib/fatfs: ff.h, diskio.h and ffunicode.c unmodified; ffconf.h is
ours (km003c's, plus FF_YIELD below); ff.c has one local change:

  FF_YIELD()  called in f_mkfs's exFAT up-case table loops (both: the
              per-character loop and its run-length scan), defaulting to
              nothing. They make 65536+ ff_wtoupper() calls without a disk
              access, so the storage worker never got to yield: one 227 ms
              main-loop stall per exFAT format (bench 2026-10-20).
              ffconf.h maps it to ff_yield() (src/sd/sd_diskio.c).
              diff against the stock file: 6 lines. Used by the optional SD card (CONFIG_SD,
src/sd/). License: LICENSE.txt (1-clause BSD style).

ffconf.h changes from the stock file:
  FF_FS_EXFAT   1     cards over 32 GB come exFAT-formatted
  FF_LBA64      1     exFAT on large cards
  FF_FS_RPATH   0     no current directory: every path is absolute
  FF_VOLUMES    1     one card
  FF_NORTC_YEAR 2026  no RTC: every file gets this fixed timestamp
  FF_FS_TINY    1     no 512-byte buffer per open file (~60 B each instead
                      of ~600)
  FF_USE_MKFS   1     Settings › SD card › Format (src/sd/sd_api.c)
  FF_MIN_GPT    2^32  never GPT: the format always writes an MBR table
                      (which covers 2 TiB, more than any SD card in SPI mode)
  FF_MAX_LFN    64    names up to 64 characters; 255 would
  FF_LFN_BUF    64    cost ~1 KB more of LFN and exFAT directory buffers.
                      A longer name on the card is skipped by listings
                      and lookups, never misread.
